gen-fredoka-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC carries a dignified, literary voice, with softly modulated strokes and tall lowercase forms that stand up like cast iron capitals. Fredoka's round, friendly line gives way to it.
gen-fredoka-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab reads traditional and refined, its robust downstrokes meeting slender turns in a sizable lowercase made for screens. Fredoka's rounded display friendliness sits above it, and the slab keeps things grounded.
gen-fredoka-gf-ovo: Fredoka draws its whole line at a single width, soft and approachable. Ovo follows with an authoritative serif voice, a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, so the rounded heading never feels out of place.
gen-fs-britney-dm-sans: DM Sans is friendly and approachable, with wide-set terminals on its s, set under Britney's relaxed, narrow calligraphic hand. Britney is comfortable in small doses, so give it a generous size.
gen-fs-kalam-cabin: Cozy handwriting meets tidy tubing. Kalam is at its best when it feels inviting and hand-drawn, while Cabin, a warm sans with open terminals, is best at making every letter easy to follow.
gen-fs-kalam-dm-sans: Kalam brings an inviting, hand-drawn coziness, its lines of text bundled tight. DM Sans takes over below as a plain sans with friendly, wide-set terminals, comfortable in small doses.
gen-fs-kalam-nunito-sans: Kalam looks cozy, hand-drawn and tightly bundled. Nunito Sans follows as a plain sans with soft, open-mouthed curves in its small letters, which suits a handful of lines nicely.
gen-fs-pencerio-cabin: Cabin looks like bent tubing, warm and clean, with open terminals and no stroke modulation at all. Pencerio is the formal calligraphic script above it, and it loses grace if the heading is made small.
gen-fs-pencerio-dm-sans: A clenched, closely fitted calligraphic hand defines Pencerio, graceful and formal. DM Sans lightens the page below with friendly, wide-set s terminals, and it is better for brief copy.
